title: Collatz: one real scalar, finite certificates, and ordinary return obstructions
body:
## New checkpoint: one actual real scalar and a finite arithmetic certificate

**Collatz remains OPEN.** The new density-free germ route still needs an arbitrary-source arithmetic construction. This checkpoint extracts one real derivative that already exists unconditionally, proves an explicit triadic criterion and candidate budget, and tests its remaining phases against actual ordinary dynamics.

### 1. A single actual derivative characterizes convergence

For the positive odd accelerated orbit, write $g_i=v_2(3q_i+1)$ and $A_i=\sum_{j<i}g_j$. The actual real scalar is
$$
h(q)=\sum_{i\ge0}\frac{g_i}{3^{i+1}}=2B'_q(1),
\qquad B_q(z)=\sum_{i\ge0}\frac{z^{A_i}}{3^{i+1}}.
$$

The ordinary clock bound proves unconditional real existence, effective rational enclosures, and
$$
\frac12<h(q)\le1+\frac{\log_2q}{3},\qquad h(Uq)=3h(q)-g(q).
$$

The written theorem proves
$$
\boxed{q\text{ reaches }1\iff h(q)\in\mathbb Z[1/3].}
$$

For a general positive source $n=2^bq$, the scalar is $2B'_n(1)=b+h(q)$, so the same equivalence applies. Triadic denominator clearing makes the actual scalar a positive integer. At that stage the complete ordinary equations give
$$
V(q,h)=\frac{q-1}{2^h-1},\qquad V(Uq,3h-g)\le\frac34V(q,h).
$$

[Complete proof and finite candidate algorithm](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/research/repo-synthesis-round8-20261123/GERM_BRIDGE.md) · [six Lean arithmetic theorems](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/research/repo-synthesis-round8-20261123/GermBridge.lean) · [independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/reports/2026-11-23-repo-synthesis-round8/GERM_REVIEW.md).

### 2. Total recognition and an explicit precision threshold

Given a supplied candidate $a/3^r$, its equality to the actual scalar can be decided using at most
$$
\boxed{K=4r+3\operatorname{bl}(q)}
$$
literal odd steps. The exact recognizer accepts at one or rejects an incorrect candidate by rational bounds. It has no unresolved output. A rejection concerns that candidate, not convergence of its source.

The rejection lattice also proves
$$
\boxed{h(q)=a/3^r\quad\text{or}\quad
|h(q)-a/3^r|\ge3^{-(4r+3\operatorname{bl}(q)+1)}.}
$$

A certified approximation closer than this threshold proves equality. The universal supply of such approximants remains unconstructed.

[Quantitative separation and approximation interface](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/research/repo-synthesis-round8-20261123/SCALAR_SEPARATION.md).

### 3. Complete rational phase exclusions and the same pressure maximum

After clearing powers of three from a putative actual rational scalar, its fractional parts follow a finite tripling orbit modulo its complete residual denominator d. Minimum lifts in $(1/2,3/2]$ and a verified ordinary floor give an exact block contraction test.

The written results exclude:

- Every complete residual denominator $d>1$ with a power of three congruent to minus one modulo d, with d=2 handled at its strict endpoint.
- Every residual power of two except the numerator phase {5,7} modulo 8.
- For every prime $p\ge5$, every complete residual denominator $p^k$ with $k>v_p(3^{\operatorname{ord}_p(3)}-1)$, by a full residue-fiber mean formula.
- Every phase at d=11,26,35,46,52,85,109, using literal convergence certificates for all odd starts through 31.

These are complete-denominator theorems. They cannot be applied independently to factors of an arbitrary composite denominator.

Under the previously pinned, source-qualified escaping-component product, the same attained ordinary pressure maximum m satisfies
$$
\frac12<h(m)<H_*=
\frac23\sum_{j\ge1}\frac{\lfloor j\log_2 3\rfloor}{3^j}
<\frac{152}{243}.
$$
An exact forty-term enclosure gives $H_*<0.625344347433389$. The interval still contains 5/8. Clearing a ternary denominator can move away from the pressure maximum.

[Phase families and pressure proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/research/repo-synthesis-round8-20261123/PRESSURE_CONSTRUCTION.md) · [independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/reports/2026-11-23-repo-synthesis-round8/PRESSURE_REVIEW.md) · [second phase review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/reports/2026-11-23-repo-synthesis-round8/ORDINARY_PRESSURE_REVIEW.md).

### 4. Actual ordinary returns defeat a simple high-state amortization

For every m>=1 an explicit positive ordinary source follows the complete gap word $(2,1)^m,(1,4)$, with endpoint
$$
r=\frac9{32}\left(\frac98\right)^m(q+7)-\frac{29}{16}.
$$

Its actual scalar has exactly one value above one across that segment; every other value is below one. Nevertheless r/q is unbounded across the family. The actual initial scalar approaches 7/8 from below with error between $1/(4\cdot9^{m+1})$ and $3/(8\cdot9^{m+1})$.

These actual scalar bounds use an unconditional tail estimate. They require no assumed termination of the constructed endpoint. Different m give different ordinary sources, so this is not an infinite ordinary realization of the exceptional phase.

[Construction, full carry, and scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/research/repo-synthesis-round8-20261123/ORDINARY_SELECTOR.md) · [eleven Lean arithmetic theorems](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/research/repo-synthesis-round8-20261123/OrdinarySelector.lean) · [independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/reports/2026-11-23-repo-synthesis-round8/ORDINARY_REVIEW.md).

### Verification and formal boundaries

- **17 new Lean theorems and three definitions**, freshly compiled and audited with Lean 4.34.1, pinned Mathlib, one thread, warnings as errors, and autoImplicit=false.
- Axiom union: **propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound**. No custom axiom or admitted proof in the audited dependency graph.
- **183,622 exact checks** across four lanes; normal and optimized Python outputs are byte-identical.
- The scalar lane checks 1,812 candidates on 140 convergent sources. The separation lane checks another 2,932 candidates, including 2,613 incorrect ones.
- All sixteen odd starts through 31 are replayed to one. Complete selected modular domains and the all-exponent fiber formulas have separate proof and execution boundaries.
- Twenty ordinary return examples are checked. At m=128, a 523-bit source grows by more than 992,236 times across its prescribed 258-step prefix. Its separately completed trajectory reaches one in 1,901 odd steps.
- Four sibling review reports plus [root reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/reports/2026-11-23-repo-synthesis-round8/ROOT_REVIEW.md) preserve exact science blobs.
- The [literature boundary](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/6352608dd6c04735e1f8bd86fef4ebc97b1aeacb/research/repo-synthesis-round8-20261123/LITERATURE_BOUNDARY.md) records an exact actual 7-to-11 counterexample to an overlapping claimed uniform-descent lemma; no claimed proof is imported.

The real series and analytic derivative, full modular source existence, actual all-time attachment, complete recognizer theorem, and phase-family proofs remain written mathematics. Lean verifies the specified finite arithmetic cores, including rational scalar block statements. It does not verify the full Collatz conjecture.
